problem: Given that $‖u‖=3$ and $u\cdot v=4$, find the smallest possible value of $‖v‖.$
worked_solution:
Using the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality, we have 

$$
\begin{aligned}|u\cdot v| & \le ‖u‖\cdot ‖v‖ \\ |4| & \le 3\cdot ‖v‖ \\ 4 & \le 3\cdot ‖v‖.\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we multiply both sides of the inequality by $\frac{1}{3}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{3}\cdot 4 & \le \frac{1}{3}\cdot 3\cdot ‖v‖ \\ \frac{4}{3} & \le ‖v‖\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the smallest possible value of $‖v‖$
is  $\frac{4}{3}.$
